eval: grouped (repo,cve) split, scan-faithful: TP=P(before)>=t & P(after)<t; noise=P(after)>=t; t frozen on val per model
dataset: data/cvefixes_clean.duckdb (1643 pairs; test n=257, val n=229)

v20.note: trained on old 3637-row table; 100% of clean test/val pairs were in that table -> numbers still memorization-inflated; true unseen-repo performance unknown/lower

v21.rule: plan-exact: gate 0.97, strict improvement on val scan_detection + 0.05 FP penalty
v21.note: epochs 3-6 gated out (generic ranking ~0.94 < 0.97); gate calibrated on v20 mix (ratio 1.0), not the phase-2 mix (ratio 0.4 + hard negatives)

v21b.rule: ablation: gate 0.93 (from training dynamics only), otherwise identical

headline_reality_check: v20 full-table 62.39%/0.44% was train-set performance; on grouped test it is 22.6%/40.1% (still inflated by 100% pair overlap with its training table)
phase3_smoking_gun: 53% of test functions exceed 512 tokens; v20 noise on truncated bucket = 65.7%; v21/v21b training dropped 171/1157 long-diff pairs as collisions -> diff-centered crop + sliding windows is the next lever
env_default: models/vuln-classifier-v21b (val-selected by the phase-2 rule; flip one line in .env to revert to v21)
